title: Josie v1 Multi-Job Campaign — Clean Qualified Retry
objective: Complete a three-stage bounded Josie v1 analysis using explicit evidence sources, fresh output files, and realistic local-model time budgets.

jobs.title: Build Josie v1 Baseline
jobs.objective: Read ONLY these files: mission_manager/06_AUTONOMOUS_MISSION_GATE.md, mission_manager/09_LIVE_GATE2_CLOSURE.md, mission_manager/10_REMOTE_SUBMISSION_BRIDGE.md, and supervisor/README.md. Create reports/josie_v1_baseline_campaign004.md summarizing only what these sources prove is operational. Include Mission Manager durability, Supervisor machine acceptance, coding worker routing/fallback, phone mission submission/execution, receipts, and idempotency. Clearly distinguish proven facts from unknowns. Do not search the repository.
jobs.first_action: Read the four explicitly listed evidence files and write the baseline report.

argv: from pathlib import Path; content=Path('reports/josie_v1_baseline_campaign004.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); t=content.lower(); assert len(content) > 1000 and 'mission manager' in t and 'supervisor' in t and 'phone' in t

jobs.title: Analyze Remaining Josie Gaps
jobs.objective: Read ONLY reports/josie_v1_baseline_campaign004.md and mission_manager/10_REMOTE_SUBMISSION_BRIDGE.md. Create reports/josie_v1_gap_analysis_campaign004.md identifying evidence-backed remaining practical gaps. Organize them under NOW, SOON, and LATER. Do not search the repository and do not redesign already-qualified infrastructure.
jobs.first_action: Read the completed baseline and remote submission report, then write the gap analysis.

argv: from pathlib import Path; t=Path('reports/josie_v1_gap_analysis_campaign004.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert len(t) > 800 and 'NOW' in t and 'SOON' in t and 'LATER' in t

jobs.title: Create Josie v1 Priority Plan
jobs.objective: Read ONLY reports/josie_v1_baseline_campaign004.md and reports/josie_v1_gap_analysis_campaign004.md. Create reports/josie_v1_next_actions_campaign004.md. Rank the five highest-value next actions. For the top three, provide a future Mission Manager job with objective, allowed scope, and machine-verifiable acceptance criteria. Prefer useful real-world work over more infrastructure changes unless a proven gap blocks reliable use.
jobs.first_action: Read the two completed campaign reports and write the prioritized action plan.

argv: from pathlib import Path; t=Path('reports/josie_v1_next_actions_campaign004.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert len(t) > 1000 and '1.' in t and '2.' in t and '3.' in t and 'acceptance' in t.lower()
